mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT prp.FACTORY_CODE, prp.MATERIAL_CODE, prp.MATERIAL_DESC, msc.MES_CAPACITY, msc.STANDARD_CAPACITY, msc.APS_CAPACITY, msc.VULCANIZATION_TIME FROM t_mp_product_require_plan prp LEFT JOIN t_mdm_sku_lh_capacity msc ON msc.FACTORY_CODE = prp.FACTORY_CODE AND msc.MATERIAL_DESC = prp.MATERIAL_DESC AND IFNULL(msc.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 WHERE IFNULL(prp.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND prp.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND prp.YEAR = #{year,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH = #{month,jdbcType=DECIMAL} AND prp.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
